This is ChainBrain: a safety net for AI that spends money.
Built by three students from Universiti Malaya and Universiti Putra Malaysia, for Topic F: the agent wallet.
Today, you either give an AI agent your whole wallet, or you approve every payment yourself.
ChainBrain gives each agent its own card, with two safety nets.
A Brain that watches every payment, and learns from you.
And a smart contract on FISCO BCOS that holds, even when the AI is fooled.

text: Here's how it feels. I tell ChainBrain what the agent is for, in plain words.
Then it builds the card in front of me, an app inside the app: the layout, the rules, and the exact spec I'm about to sign.
One slide, and the card gets its own contract.
It asks one question instead of guessing.
Then the agent works alone, paying data sellers per request over x402: Exa for search, CoinGecko for prices.
say: Then the agent works alone, paying data sellers per request over x four oh two: Ex-uh for search, Coin Gecko for prices.

text: Nansen's check is above my ask-me limit, so the card asks me first. One slide.
A seller that isn't on my list is refused, and the agent re-plans to one that is.
It even haggles. DataPro asked twelve dollars. The agent settled at eight eighty.
Now, let's attack it.
A seller hides an order in its page. The agent quotes it back, and ignores it.
Another asks for my name, my email, and a signature. Refused.
I'm the admin. Raise the cap. Only my key can change a card.
And the worst case: we fool the agent on purpose, and force a transfer out.
The card refuses it. The balance doesn't move.
Repeated refusals in under a minute, and the Sentinel, a second AI, freezes the card. Only I can unfreeze it.
Every event feeds the Brain.
Radar checks who the agent pays, and blocks a seller once a drainer has paid it.
Pre-flight predicts each payment before it's sent. And memory learns how I like to buy. I can make it forget anything.
The AI can only ever tighten the rules. Never loosen them.
I'm always in charge. Revoke a card mid-task, and the money comes back.
If a job doesn't fit, the agent stops, and offers a one-tap fix.
The phone in this video ran our built-in network. The same contract runs on our hosted FISCO BCOS chain.
